description: Create a limit sell order — sell a token when price reaches target. Auto-classifies as TP or SL.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

amount.description: Token amount in raw units (token decimals), a positive integer string

triggerPrice.description: USD price at which to trigger the sell (plain decimal)

name: limit_sell
